$comment: Human-readable baseline record. The AUTHORITATIVE integrity values live in REVIEW_PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json, which the gate reads. Commit SHAs here are provenance evidence, not integrity proof.
source_baseline_meaning: The commit at which MVP v0.1 product code was frozen. Immutable. Never overwritten by a documentation change.
reason: Documentation-only handoff and evidence refresh commits after product freeze

working_tree_content.method: sha256 over the per-file sha256sum listing of 'git ls-files' across src, data, schemas, tests, package.json, tsconfig.json, sorted by path (working-tree CONTENT).
working_tree_content.note: Retained for history. Narrower scope than the manifest's source hash and no longer the gate value.

working_tree_method.method: sha256 of 'git ls-files -s' over src, data, schemas, tests, package.json, tsconfig.json (working tree)
working_tree_method.note: Superseded as the gate value. Retained so the value recorded in v0.1 stays verifiable. NOT used by the gate: 'git ls-files -s' hashes the index, not working-tree content, so it cannot detect an uncommitted product-source edit.

commit_addressable_narrow.method: sha256 of sorted 'git ls-tree -r <commit>' entries over oss-integration/{src,data,schemas,tests,package.json,tsconfig.json}
commit_addressable_narrow.note: Commit-addressable equivalent of the original scope, so both commits can be compared without a checkout.

commit_addressable_broad.method: sha256 of sorted 'git ls-tree -r <commit>' entries over oss-integration/{src,data,schemas,tests,skills,generated,examples,benchmark,package.json,package-lock.json,tsconfig.json}
commit_addressable_broad.note: Widened product scope: adds skills/, the generated plugin, examples/ and benchmark/. Review documentation is excluded by construction.

intervening_commits.subject: chore: finalize external Codex review handoff
intervening_commits.why_needed: Built the external review package: four prompts, evidence files, both runners, result drop zone and README links.

intervening_commits.subject: chore: finalize external Codex review handoff
intervening_commits.why_needed: Moved evidence under evidence/, marked per-repeat timings NOT_AVAILABLE, added CLAIM 11, added RUN_METADATA and review-completeness tracking to both runners.

intervening_commits.subject: docs: refresh Codex auth and environment evidence
intervening_commits.why_needed: The Codex CLI was installed, so the committed 'no ~/.codex' evidence statement went stale. Corrected to the measured state without changing the conclusion or deleting the earlier observation.

review_target_rule.product_source: Identical to 04fab5b. Codex reviews the frozen product code.
review_target_rule.evidence_and_review_package: 946158a. Codex reads the corrected evidence, not the stale copy.

product_code_frozen_until: external Codex findings are returned, reproduced and classified
review_package_commit_meaning: The commit carrying the evidence, prompts, runners and handoff documentation that Codex actually reads. Later than the source baseline, and documentation-only.
